fixRoleBlock:

1. Aw ye salon paramɛtɛr wuli → Permission

3. Aw ye nin check kura
fixMissingPerm:
Ka a ɲɛ:
1. Aw ye server paramɛtɛr wuli → Role
2. Aw ye **{bot}** wuli ka **{perms}** di a ma
3. Aw ye nin check kura
fixGone: Ka a ɲɛ: aw ye salon wɛrɛ sugandi nin baara ye, dashboard kɔnɔ walima command min ye a labɛn.
whyWrongType: {channel} ye forum, media salon walima category ye: n tɛ se ka sɛbɛn na yen.
fixWrongType: Ka a ɲɛ: aw ye texte salon sugandi.
whyThreadLocked: Nin fil datara, o la moderator dɔrɔnw bɛ se ka sɛbɛn na yen.
fixThreadLocked: Ka a ɲɛ: aw ye fil da, ka **{perms}** di **{bot}** role ma, walima aw ye salon wɛrɛ sugandi.
whyTimeout: **{bot}** bɛ timeout la nin server la, o la a tɛ se ka foyi ci.
fixTimeout: Ka a ɲɛ: aw ye bolofara tigi **{bot}** kan member lisiti kɔnɔ ka timeout bɔ a la.
whyRefused: Discord balira message la hali n ka permission caman ɲi.
fixRefused:
Ka a ɲɛ:
1. Aw ye salon paramɛtɛr wuli → Permission
2. Aw ye a lajɛ ko **{bot}** bɛ se ka **View Channel**, **Send Messages**, **Embed Links** ani **Attach Files** kɛ
3. Aw ye nin check kura
